title: Commercial Building Maintenance and Everyday Repairs
heroCopy: We repair doors, hardware, walls, ceilings, fixed joinery and shared facilities. We inspect the damage, agree on the scope and record the work at handover.

problems.label: Doors that stick or have loose hardware

solution.heading: Door and Hardware Repairs
solution.inspection: We inspect door leaves, frames, hinges and latches.
solution.method: We realign the door, secure the fixings or replace damaged parts.
solution.check: We check that the door opens, closes and locks properly, then record the repairs.

solution.heading: Wall Damage and Joint Repairs
solution.inspection: We assess the extent of damage, panel and substrate condition, noting moisture or abnormal connections.
solution.method: We treat damaged substrate, patch or replace affected panels, then restore joints and finishes.
solution.check: We check surface levelness, sealing and surrounding protection, recording completed areas.

solution.heading: Ceiling Stain and Panel Repairs
solution.inspection: We inspect panels, supports and adjacent equipment, identifying water marks and damaged areas.
solution.method: We repair affected areas in order of priority, then replace or restore damaged ceiling panels.
solution.check: We verify panel installation, joints and surrounding finishes, and organise before‑and‑after photos.

solution.heading: Fixed Cabinet and Trim Repairs
solution.inspection: We inspect cabinets, hardware, connection points and adjacent wall and floor conditions.
solution.method: We adjust or replace damaged parts, reinforce connections and repair local trim.
solution.check: We examine cabinet doors, drawers and fixed components for use, confirming the scope of work.

items.title: Replace damaged parts
items.body: We replace damaged hardware, panels or functional parts.

workflow.body: We assess damage, dimensions and access conditions.

workflow.title: Agree on the scope
workflow.body: We confirm methods, materials and pricing.

workflow.title: Carry out the work in stages
workflow.body: We plan site protection, book the trades and agree on the order of work.

workflow.title: Check the work and hand over
workflow.body: We check that the repaired area works as intended and note anything that needs follow-up.

faq.question: Can you take care of several repairs in one visit?
faq.answer: Yes. We review the faults and access requirements, then group the work and arrange the trades it needs.

faq.question: When do you patch damage, and when do you replace the part?
faq.answer: We check how far the damage extends and the condition of the surrounding materials and fixings. We explain what can be patched and what needs replacing.

faq.question: If the ceiling shows water marks, should we fix leaks first?
faq.answer: We first inspect the water‑affected areas and then outline the sequence of leak repair and ceiling restoration.

faq.question: Can you schedule repairs around our business hours?
faq.answer: We plan the work around your operating hours and access routes, and explain which areas we need to access at each stage.

title: Roofing, Waterproofing & Building Repairs
heroCopy: We investigate commercial roof leaks and repair gutters, downpipes, flashings and waterproofing. We use the signs of water ingress and the condition of the roof to work out what needs repairing.

solution.heading: Roof Leak & Flashing Repair
solution.inspection: We use indoor water stains to inspect the corresponding roof, seams, roof penetrations and drainage paths.
solution.method: We repair or replace damaged roof panels, flashing and waterproofing seals on site.
solution.check: We check connections and drainage, record treated areas and any follow‑up observations.

problems.label: Water pooling or overflowing in a box gutter

solution.heading: Box gutter and downpipe maintenance
solution.inspection: We inspect standing water locations, outlets, downpipes and connections to clarify the drainage path.
solution.method: We clear blockages or damaged sections, repair connections and specify any gutter components that need replacement.
solution.check: We verify drainage and connections at treated areas and provide hand‑over photos.

solution.heading: Roof seam and flashing repairs
solution.inspection: We inspect lap joints, fix points, wall edges and roof penetrations, noting loose or damaged areas.
solution.method: We repair or replace relevant roof panels, flashing and connection parts as required.
solution.check: We recheck connections and seals, then record where we worked and anything that needs follow-up.

solution.heading: Waterproofing membrane and substrate repairs
solution.inspection: We inspect blistering, cracking, corners and substrate condition, distinguishing surface damage from underlying issues.
solution.method: We identify affected areas, treat the substrate and complete the corresponding waterproofing layer and seal repairs.
solution.check: We check the repairs against the agreed scope and record the materials and work completed.

items.title: Roof & Fix Points

items.title: Roof Penetrations & Flashing
items.body: We inspect equipment penetrations, wall edges and seals.

items.title: Gutters & Downpipes
items.body: We inspect drainage paths, standing water locations and connections.

items.title: Waterproofing Layer & Sub‑strate
items.body: We inspect surface damage, corners and substrate condition.

workflow.title: Check water stains and inspect the roof
workflow.body: We record problem locations and associated roof areas.

workflow.body: We explain what needs repair, which materials we will use and how the connections will be repaired.

workflow.title: Plan access and schedule the work
workflow.body: We arrange roof access and site protection, and schedule the work around the weather.

workflow.title: Check connections and drainage
workflow.body: We inspect treated areas and provide before/after photos.

faq.question: Do I need to replace the entire roof for leak repairs?
faq.answer: We assess the extent of the damage and check the seams, flashings and drainage. Then we explain whether we can repair the affected area or need to replace components.

faq.question: Can you repair a box gutter and its downpipes together?
faq.answer: Yes. We check the box gutter, outlet and downpipe as one drainage run, then confirm which sections need work.

faq.question: Can you repair the damaged ceiling as well as the roof?
faq.answer: We can coordinate roof repairs and ceiling reinstatement in the same job, with the ceiling work scheduled after we address the source of the leak.

faq.question: How do you quote on a roof leak?
faq.answer: We start with the property address and where the leak shows up. We confirm the roof type, access and what needs inspecting before setting out the repair scope.

title: Commercial Electrical & Lighting
heroCopy: We investigate electrical faults and repair or upgrade lighting, switches and power points. We check the equipment, circuits and how each area is used before scheduling the work.

solution.heading: Lighting Faults & Fixture Updates
solution.inspection: We inspect fixtures, controls and related circuits, distinguishing single fixture issues from area-wide problems.
solution.method: We replace faulty components or upgrade fittings to suit the location and how the area is used.
solution.check: We test lighting and control functions, recording completed work.

solution.heading: Circuit & Power Issue Resolution
solution.inspection: We examine relevant equipment, circuits and power connections to determine the scope of the problem.
solution.method: We address faulty components or connections per the inspection, and identify items that need updating.
solution.check: We test the affected circuits and equipment, documenting completed repairs.

problems.label: Damaged switches or too few power points

solution.heading: Switch and power point repairs and upgrades
solution.inspection: We verify equipment use, existing points, installation locations and power conditions.
solution.method: We repair or replace damaged points and, within the confirmed scope, add new or relocate existing ones.
solution.check: We test the affected fittings and equipment and check the installation against the work records.

problems.label: Insufficient lighting in corridors or work areas

solution.heading: Corridor & Work Area Lighting Updates
solution.inspection: We review work positions, mounting heights, shelving obstructions and existing fixtures and control zones.
solution.method: We update fixtures or adjust layouts within the confirmed scope, aligning lighting with actual use areas.
solution.check: We assess lighting and control performance, recording fixture positions and completed items.

specialistModule.layout: A wide commercial space model with a blue background spans the page, with three cream‑white scene tags below. Switching between office, corridor and warehouse tags lights up only the corresponding area with a fluorescent yellow strip; a narrow orange sidebar on the right shows the key points for that area. items.title: Office & Reception
items.body: We coordinate lighting updates with workstations, reception areas and existing fixture placements.

items.title: Corridors & Public Areas
items.body: We inspect passage routes, control methods and lighting zones.

items.title: Warehouses & Work Zones
items.body: We determine fixture placement based on mounting height, shelving and work positions.

workflow.title: Confirm the equipment and fault
workflow.body: We record the fault and how the affected area is used.

workflow.title: Inspect the site and agree on the scope
workflow.body: We identify the affected circuits and components and confirm how the work will be carried out.

workflow.title: Schedule work around site access
workflow.body: We agree on when the work can take place and which areas it will affect.

workflow.title: Electrical testing and handover
workflow.body: We arrange for licensed electricians to check the affected circuits and equipment, then provide the work records.

faq.question: Can you repair a single light fitting or one area?
faq.answer: Yes. We look at the affected fitting, controls and circuit, then set out the work needed for that fitting or area.

faq.question: Will lighting updates affect business operations?
faq.answer: We schedule work around the affected circuits, work areas and your business hours. We let you know in advance where access or temporary closures are needed.

faq.question: Can you install switches and power points during the same job?
faq.answer: Yes. We check equipment locations, the existing supply and power requirements before we specify the fittings and electrical work.

faq.question: How do you quote on a lighting upgrade?
faq.answer: We confirm the type and number of fittings, mounting heights, controls and access. We check those details on site before finalising the scope.

title: Plumbing, Drainage & Gas
heroCopy: We clear blocked drains and repair leaks, hot water systems and gas connections at commercial premises. We check the pipework, connections and equipment before recommending what to repair or replace.

solution.heading: Commercial Drainage Blockage & Pipe Repairs
solution.inspection: We inspect affected fixtures, drain connections and pipe runs, and probe inside pipes as needed.
solution.method: Based on the inspection we clear blockages and identify damaged pipe sections or joints that need fixing.
solution.check: We test the drain and connections, then record the work and any follow-up needed.

solution.heading: Pipe and Joint Leak Repairs
solution.inspection: We trace the leak and check the affected pipework, valves and fixture connections.
solution.method: We repair or replace damaged components and define the scope for any finish restoration.
solution.check: We test the connections in use and record where we carried out repairs and any follow-up needed.

problems.label: Insufficient hot water or fluctuating temperatures

solution.heading: Commercial Hot Water Equipment Maintenance & Upgrade
solution.inspection: We verify equipment condition, connections, temperature performance and on-site water demand.
solution.method: We repair relevant parts or outline equipment upgrade and connection work based on the inspection.
solution.check: We test equipment operation and hot water performance, recording any repairs or replacements.

problems.label: Gas equipment connection and upgrade needs

solution.heading: Gas Equipment Connection & Upgrade
solution.inspection: We review the equipment, existing connections and installation conditions to define the scope of work.
solution.method: We arrange connection, repair or upgrade work according to confirmed equipment and site requirements.
solution.check: We complete functional checks, recording connection and equipment work items.

items.body: We confirm which connections need attention and what to repair or upgrade after checking the equipment and site.

workflow.title: Schedule repairs or replacements

workflow.body: We test the repaired systems and document completion.

faq.question: Can you investigate several slow drains at once?
faq.answer: Yes. We inspect the affected fixtures and shared pipework to find where the restriction starts.

faq.question: Will you need to turn off the water or shut down equipment?
faq.answer: We identify what needs isolating, agree on any interruptions and explain how the affected areas will be returned to use.

faq.question: Can you inspect the hot water unit and its connections together?
faq.answer: Yes. We check the hot water equipment, connections and demand, then explain what needs repair or replacement.

faq.question: Can you coordinate plumbing, drainage and equipment upgrades?
faq.answer: Yes. We look at how the systems connect and schedule the work around how you use the site.

title: HVAC and Building Systems
heroCopy: We service commercial air conditioning, return-air components, condensate drains and controls. We investigate faults and schedule the work around your operating hours.

problems.label: Poor heating or cooling, or uneven temperatures

solution.heading: Zone temperature and return‑air issues
solution.inspection: We verify equipment operation, zone settings and return‑air status, recording affected locations and times.
solution.method: Based on the inspection we clean and maintain relevant components, address control or component faults, and identify items that need replacement.
solution.check: After completion we check operating status, return‑air performance and condensate discharge, and record the work performed.

solution.heading: Condensate drain inspection and repairs
solution.inspection: We inspect condensate pans, discharge paths, connections and surrounding finishes that may be affected.
solution.method: We clear blockages or damaged connections, then determine the scope of finish restoration required.
solution.check: We check drainage and equipment operation, recording the location of work and any follow‑up actions.

solution.heading: Investigating noise, vibration and shutdowns
solution.inspection: We record the times when anomalies occur, inspect equipment operation, fixed parts and control behaviour.
solution.method: Based on the inspection we adjust relevant components, repair or replace damaged items.
solution.check: We check equipment operation and response, compiling repair and replacement records.

problems.label: Dust on grilles, return‑air performance changes

solution.heading: Grille and return‑air component maintenance
solution.inspection: We inspect grilles, filter components and return‑air paths for dust and operating status.
solution.method: We clean and maintain relevant components, identifying parts that need repair or replacement.
solution.check: We check return‑air performance and on-site cleaning, recording completed items.

workflow.body: We inspect equipment, airflow, drainage and control performance.

workflow.title: Operational checks and handover
workflow.body: We check how the equipment runs and record the completed work and any follow-up maintenance.

faq.question: Can you investigate hot and cold spots in the same building?
faq.answer: Yes. We check the affected zones, return air and operating schedules to find out why temperatures differ.

faq.question: Can you fix an air conditioning leak and the ceiling damage it caused?
faq.answer: We trace where the condensate is coming from and how it drains. Then we arrange the drainage repair and reinstate the affected ceiling in the right order.

faq.question: Can maintenance be scheduled around office or business hours?
faq.answer: We plan access around the equipment location and your operating hours, and tell you which areas the work will affect.

faq.question: What details help you assess an air conditioning fault?
faq.answer: The equipment’s location, model and when the fault occurs can help us prepare. If you already have a photo of the unit or its label, you can include it with your enquiry.

title: Fire, Security and Access Control
heroCopy: We inspect and maintain fire safety equipment, access controls and security systems at commercial premises. We help resolve equipment and access faults and arrange routine maintenance.

problems.label: Card reader faults or difficulty gaining access

solution.heading: Access control and entry equipment maintenance
solution.inspection: We check the condition of card readers, doors, controls and power connections to pinpoint where the fault occurs.
solution.method: We repair or replace affected components within the fault scope and resolve door-to-system coordination issues.
solution.check: On completion we verify authorised access, door closing and system response, and record the adjustments made.

solution.heading: Commercial intercom maintenance
solution.inspection: We confirm device location, audio and video performance, connections and related power supply.
solution.method: We repair or replace components based on findings and resolve installation and connection issues.
solution.check: We test call, audio and video functions and record adjustments.

solution.heading: Security equipment and connection maintenance
solution.inspection: We check camera mounting positions, connection status and the areas requiring coverage on site.
solution.method: We address faulty components and connections, and adjust mounting positions to the confirmed coverage scope.
solution.check: We review equipment performance and compile adjustments and replacements.

solution.heading: Fire safety equipment maintenance
solution.inspection: We verify equipment location, visible condition and fault records to identify items requiring attention.
solution.method: We complete maintenance, repair or replacement of relevant equipment within the agreed scope.
solution.check: We compile equipment work and inspection records and hand over any follow-up items.

faq.question: Can you investigate door closing and card reader faults at the same time?
faq.answer: Yes. We check the door, hardware and access controls together to find out whether the fault is mechanical or part of the access system.

faq.question: Can you update the access system when a tenancy changes hands?
faq.answer: We review how the new tenant will use the premises and work out which access equipment can stay, which needs adjusting and which needs replacing.

faq.question: What helps you prepare for a security or access service visit?
faq.answer: We start with where and when the fault occurs. Equipment details or maintenance records can help us bring the right information to the visit.

faq.question: Do you record parts replaced and adjustments made?
faq.answer: Yes. At handover we summarise what we repaired, which parts we replaced and the results of our checks.

title: Commercial Landscaping and Irrigation
heroCopy: We maintain commercial grounds, entrances and courtyards. We look after lawns, garden beds, pruning and irrigation to keep outdoor areas tidy and usable.

solution.heading: Landscape edges and routine care
solution.inspection: We inspect the boundaries between lawns, garden beds, planting and pedestrian paths.
solution.method: We prune, remove weeds and green waste, restore edges and replenish or update local areas as needed.
solution.check: We check access space, garden edges and site clean-up, and record follow-up maintenance.

solution.heading: Shrub pruning and path clearance
solution.inspection: We review plant growth, site boundaries and pedestrian and vehicle routes.
solution.method: We prune within the agreed scope, remove cuttings and tidy adjacent areas.
solution.check: We check path clearance, pruning boundaries and site clean-up.

solution.heading: Sprinkler and irrigation repairs
solution.inspection: We check sprinklers, drip lines, connections and controls, noting areas with uneven watering.
solution.method: We repair or replace damaged components and adjust irrigation within the agreed site scope.
solution.check: We test water flow and connections, then record where the work was carried out.

problems.label: Untidy beds and gaps in planting

solution.heading: Garden bed care and replacement planting
solution.inspection: We review the planting space, existing plants, boundaries and areas needing renewal.
solution.method: We remove weeds and green waste, tidy beds and replace planting within the agreed scope.
solution.check: We confirm completed areas and clean-up, and note follow-up maintenance.

faq.question: Can pruning and irrigation repairs be arranged together?
faq.answer: We review the planting areas and irrigation performance together, then arrange pruning, cleaning and equipment repairs around the scope.

faq.question: Can you maintain landscaping around commercial entrances and car parks?
faq.answer: We can maintain planting around entrances, paths, garden strips and car park boundaries, arranging work around site access.

faq.question: Can you refresh part of a garden bed or replace missing plants?

faq.question: Can you set up a regular grounds maintenance schedule?

solution.check: We check the installation and appearance and record the repair scope.

faq.question: Can you coordinate shopfront, entrance and internal signs?

title: Façade and High-Access Cleaning
heroCopy: We clean commercial façades, glazing and elevated surfaces. We plan the work in stages to suit the materials, staining and site access.

problems.label: Dusty glass and visible water marks

solution.heading: Glass and window frame cleaning
solution.inspection: We review glass, frames, staining and surrounding access conditions.
solution.method: We clean to suit the surface, address dirt around edges and protect adjacent finishes.
solution.check: We check water marks, residue and frame details and organise completion photos.

solution.heading: Cleaning stains and rain streaks from façades
solution.inspection: We review materials, stain patterns, joints and nearby access.
solution.method: We select a method for the material, complete a sample area, then protect adjacent surfaces and clean in sections.
solution.check: We check consistency, edges and residue and record any surface damage found.

solution.heading: Canopy and elevated surface cleaning
solution.inspection: We review materials, dirt distribution, access and the areas in use below.
solution.method: We clean the agreed elevated sections, protecting related equipment and finishes.
solution.check: We recheck edges and residue and record the work area and issues found.

problems.label: Cleaning above an entrance affects access

solution.heading: Staged cleaning around entrances
solution.inspection: We review pedestrian routes, business hours and the work area above the entrance.
solution.method: We define work areas and access sequence, then carry out cleaning to the agreed plan.
solution.check: We check completion and site clean-up and hand over access restoration and follow-up items.
